# Copilot Instructions — Trouve ta moitié


## ⚠️ Next.js version warning
This project runs **Next.js 16.2.1** and **React 19.2.4** — APIs differ from training data. Before writing any Next.js-specific code, read the relevant guide in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/`. Heed deprecation notices in those docs.

## Project overview
A French-language social icebreaker game. The admin sets up pairs of words, launches the game, then players register, receive a secret word, and mingle to find their matching partner using 4-digit codes or QR codes.

**User flow:**
```
/ (landing, enter room code) → /join?room=XXXXX (register name)
  → /mission?code=XXXX&room=XXXXX → /find?myCode=XXXX&room=XXXXX
  → /confirm?myCode=X&theirCode=Y&room=XXXXX → /done?myCode=X&theirName=Y&room=XXXXX
```

**Admin flow:**
```
/ → /admin  (create/load room, enter pairs, launch game, track players)
```

## Architecture
- **Client-side SPA** — no backend, no API routes.
- **All shared game state lives in Firebase Firestore** via `app/lib/db.ts`. Each game is one document at `/games/{roomCode}` with the shape of `GameState`.
- **Room codes** are 5-character alphanumeric strings (no confusable chars O/0/I/1) generated by `generateRoomCode()` in `app/admin/page.tsx`. Admin's last room is saved in `sessionStorage` under key `ttm_admin_room`.
- **Player identity is passed via URL search params** — every page reads `code` and `room` with `useSearchParams()` from `next/navigation`.
- Every page file uses `"use client"`.
- `app/lib/store.ts` still contains types and pure logic helpers; `loadState`/`saveState` (localStorage) are legacy and should not be used in new code.

## Data model (`app/lib/store.ts`)
```ts
GameState {
  status: "waiting" | "playing" | "finished"
  nextCode: number          // auto-incremented to generate 4-digit player codes
  pairs: Pair[]             // e.g. { wordA:"Soleil", wordB:"Lune" }
  players: Player[]
  accentColor: string       // hex e.g. "#E91E63" — applied to player-facing UI
  gameMode: string          // e.g. "its-a-match"
}
Player {
  code: string              // zero-padded 4 digits, e.g. "0042"
  name: string
  pairId: number            // links to Pair
  half: "A" | "B"           // which word they hold
  partnerCode: string       // correct partner's code — used for match validation
  matched: boolean
}
```
Key helpers: `registerPlayer`, `confirmMatch`, `getMotieWord`, `getPlayerByCode`.

## Firebase (`app/lib/firebase.ts` + `app/lib/db.ts`)
- `firebase.ts` initialises the Firebase app from `NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_*` env vars and exports `db` (Firestore).
- `db.ts` exports:
  - `loadRoom(roomCode)` — one-time read, returns `GameState | null`
  - `saveRoom(roomCode, state)` — full document write
  - `subscribeRoom(roomCode, onChange)` — real-time `onSnapshot`, returns unsubscribe fn
- **All player pages** use `loadRoom` / `saveRoom`. The admin page also uses `subscribeRoom` for live updates.
- Required env vars (see `.env.local.example`):
  ```
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
  NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID
  ```

## Accent color
`GameState.accentColor` (hex string, default `#000000`) is set by the admin and applied to player-facing UI via `style={{ backgroundColor: accent }}`. Load it from `loadRoom` at the top of each player page.

## Game modes
`GameState.gameMode` (string ID). The registry array `GAME_MODES` lives at the top of `app/admin/page.tsx`. Only `its-a-match` is currently available.

## QR scanning (`/find`)
Uses `@zxing/browser` `BrowserQRCodeReader`. Loaded dynamically (`await import("@zxing/browser")`) to keep the bundle lean. The scanner calls `reader.decodeFromVideoDevice(undefined, videoRef.current, callback)` which returns an `IScannerControls` — store it and call `controls.stop()` to cancel. `BrowserQRCodeReader` has no `reset()` method.

## Key conventions

### Language
All UI text must be written in **French**.

### Client components
All pages are Client Components — add `"use client"` at the top of every new page or interactive component.

### Navigation
Use `<Link href="...">` from `next/link` for all client-side transitions. Always include `?room=XXXXX` in every player navigation link.

### Suspense requirement
`useSearchParams()` must be inside a `<Suspense>` boundary. Pattern used throughout: the default export renders `<Suspense><InnerComponent /></Suspense>`, actual logic is in the inner function.

### Tailwind CSS v4
Import syntax: `@import "tailwindcss"` — **not** `@tailwind base/components/utilities`. Theme tokens use `@theme inline { ... }` in `app/globals.css`.

### Path alias
`@/*` resolves to the project root — e.g. `import { loadRoom } from "@/app/lib/db"`.

## Developer commands
```bash
npm run dev      # start dev server on http://localhost:3000
npm run build    # production build
npm run lint     # ESLint
```
No test runner is configured.

## Key files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `app/lib/store.ts` | Types + pure game logic helpers (`registerPlayer`, `confirmMatch`, etc.) |
| `app/lib/firebase.ts` | Firebase app init, exports `db` |
| `app/lib/db.ts` | Firestore adapter: `loadRoom`, `saveRoom`, `subscribeRoom` |
| `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout — Geist fonts, Tailwind body classes |
| `app/globals.css` | Tailwind v4 import + CSS custom properties |
| `app/page.tsx` | Landing — room code entry form → `/join?room=XXXXX` |
| `app/admin/page.tsx` | Admin: room creation/loading, pair entry, game mode, accent color, launch, player tracking |
| `app/join/page.tsx` | Player registration — reads `?room=`, calls `loadRoom`/`saveRoom` |
| `app/mission/page.tsx` | Shows player's code, QR code, and moitié word; reads `?code=&room=` |
| `app/find/page.tsx` | QR camera scanner + manual 4-digit code entry; reads `?myCode=&room=` |
| `app/confirm/page.tsx` | Shows both halves — confirm or reject match; reads `?myCode=&theirCode=&room=` |
| `app/done/page.tsx` | Celebration screen; reads `?myCode=&theirName=&room=` |
| `.env.local.example` | Template for required Firebase env vars |

## Important constraints
- The game cannot be joined until admin sets status to `"playing"`. `/join` checks `state.status` and blocks with a message otherwise.
- Pairs are consumed FIFO (slot A first, then B). Once all slots are taken, registration is blocked.
- Match validation: only save a match if `me.partnerCode === theirCode`. Wrong matches show an error; no state is written.
- `/match` is a legacy redirect to `/find` — do not add logic there.
